title: Admin Buttons
features: Die button makes you never die, Touchey button kicks any player you touch.
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function keepButtonsVisible()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.5)
		if player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") then
			local gui = player.PlayerGui
			local invincibleButton = gui:FindFirstChild("Invincible") and gui.Invincible:FindFirstChild("Button")
			local kickButton = gui:FindFirstChild("Kick") and gui.Kick:FindFirstChild("Button")

			if invincibleButton then
				invincibleButton.Visible = true
			end
			if kickButton then
				kickButton.Visible = true
			end
		end
	end
end

task.spawn(keepButtonsVisible)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	task.delay(1, keepButtonsVisible)
end)
